products.name: Munch
products.note: Content repurposing AI; auto-editing; social clips; trend analysis; Israeli vendor

profile_text.body:
Munch is an Israeli company that offers an AI-powered social media content service aimed at businesses. The company describes its product, Munch Studio, as a done-for-you solution that produces on-brand social media content in a hands-free manner, with its AI engine generating posts tailored to a custom content strategy built for each business.

The core product sits in the video generation and editing category and focuses on content repurposing, auto-editing, social clip creation, and trend analysis. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
